resources.string: Bring your steps, sleep, and heart-rate summaries into WithYou when you choose.
Only compact summaries are shared with WithYou. Your detailed health history stays in Health Connect. Sync happens only while this helper is open.
This should only take a moment.

WithYou reads steps, sleep, and heart rate only after you grant access. This helper turns recent records into small summaries on your phone. Sync happens only while the helper is open. It does not upload individual heart-rate samples or your full health history. WithYou is a wellness project and does not provide a diagnosis or medical advice.
